Page 023, step by step

The page you sent: one green box on the dialogue, and no box at all on the 반짝. Both are the pipeline doing exactly what it is written to do — and this page is a better teacher than the one I picked, because it goes wrong somewhere you can point at.

1

The page goes into the square fine here

690×1900, which is 2.75× taller than wide — comfortably under the 6× that earns a warning. Scaled by 0.539.

Nothing is lost at this step on this page. Worth showing anyway, because it is the step that would ruin it if the strip were three times longer.

2

Both pieces of writing are found nothing missed

This is the first surprise: the 반짝 is not missed. The detector finds it. It disappears later, at step 6, and for a reason that has nothing to do with seeing it.

2 boxes on the page. The mask on the right has both the set dialogue and the brush-drawn effect.

3

Question one: straight edges? right answer

Scanning out from all four sides finds an edge on 0 of 4. So: not a caption. That is correct — this is an oval with a ragged fur edge, not a ruled panel.

4

Question two: paper or artwork? wrong answer

Here is where your green box comes from.

0.0% of the ring around that box counts as paper. Not a low number — zero. Under 45% means “not in a balloon”, so the box is labelled Outside text.

Every pixel of that ring is red. And it is plainly sitting in a balloon.

5

Why: the balloon is grey

The test asks whether a pixel is brighter than 200 out of 255. That is a fair description of paper in a normal comic. This balloon is a soft grey disc lit by a starfield.

The paper inside this balloon measures 143 out of 255.
The ring test wants > 200. The balloon finder wants ≥ 190.

So both of the things that could have called this a bubble fail, and they fail for the same single reason. The balloon finder from step 6 would normally rescue a box like this — a box called outside text that turns out to be inside a real balloon gets renamed — but it never gets the chance, because it does not accept this shape as a balloon either.

This is a real defect, not a tuning preference. Two independent tests share one hidden assumption — that a speech balloon is near-white — and this page breaks both at once. It is the same box you flagged months ago as “this should be a bubble box”.
The obvious fix — lower the brightness bar — is the wrong one: it would start calling dark artwork paper. The better question is whether the ring should be judged against the box's own surroundings rather than an absolute 200: this balloon is far brighter than the sky around it, which is what your eye is actually using. That has not been measured, so it has not been built.
6

The 반짝 is found, then dropped by your own setting

It came back as a sound effect, and on manhwa and manhua the detector drops those — half of what it returned as one was artwork rather than writing, so it does not offer them.

That is why your screenshot has nothing on it. To box it: draw a rectangle round it on the Translation view and press 3.
